sampling_frame.manifest_generation: exactly once per canonical attempt: use secrets.randbelow rejection sampling to draw 22 unique masters per profile, an independent uniform Fisher-Yates role permutation per profile, one independent uniform Fisher-Yates capture permutation over all 66 units, and an independent uniform Fisher-Yates arm permutation for every unit-path; write and fsync the complete SAMPLING.json before any trace capture
sampling_frame.retry_rule: never redraw any master, role, capture order or arm order because of identities, q values, traces, failure or outcome; a crash consumes the canonical scientific attempt
sampling_frame.master_draw: for each profile draw master=1_000_000_000+secrets.randbelow(8_000_000_000_000_000_000), rejecting duplicates until exactly 22 unique masters exist
sampling_frame.role_assignment: apply Fisher-Yates using fresh secrets.randbelow(i+1) draws to the 22 masters; first 19 permuted masters are calibration and last 3 evaluation
sampling_frame.capture_order: apply Fisher-Yates using fresh secrets.randbelow(i+1) draws to all 66 profile-master units; capture in that interleaved order without exposing role to the trace kernel
sampling_frame.arm_order: within each trace unit and path index, apply Fisher-Yates using fresh secrets.randbelow(i+1) draws to prefix arms 24,8,1
sampling_frame.label_blinding: trace kernel receives profile, master, path and arm order but never calibration/evaluation role; evaluation objects remain in runner memory and no evaluation-derived byte is published until all trace capture ends and q values are sealed
sampling_frame.sampling_interpretation: conditional on the complete role-blind potential trace table, the independent uniform role permutation supplies finite-population exchangeability within each profile even under arbitrary temporal host drift; validity requires OS randomness and exact Fisher-Yates execution and does not imply target exchangeability

matched_trace_unit.definition: one q-independent profile-master potential-outcome table with 16 path slots and fresh prefix arms 24,8,1 at every slot
matched_trace_unit.process_boundary: each profile-master unit runs in one fresh spawned child process; no method is executed during capture
matched_trace_unit.arm_record: for each arm retain environment construction/reset, indexed interaction suffixes, exact eligible nested returns, return-ready generation elapsed for the requested arm, actual replay elapsed and actual scorer output for every eligible return 24,8,1
matched_trace_unit.policy_projection: after q sealing, each policy walks the same evaluation table by path slot and selects only the arm matching its current proposal; policy state and admission never alter captured potential outcomes
matched_trace_unit.missing_rule: any missing arm, timeout, child failure, malformed attribution or missing eligible-return replay makes the entire profile-master trace score positive_infinity
matched_trace_unit.support_rule: calibration and evaluation both contain exactly 16 slots and all three arms; no policy may request a seventeenth slot

replay_charge.training_source: sealed invalid HCMS antecedent; shape only
replay_charge.interpretation: positive candidate scale corrected by complete-trace q_replay

atomic_generation_s.training_source: median consecutive return-ready path-publication increments in sealed invalid HCMS primary rows
atomic_generation_s.interpretation: positive arm scale corrected by complete-trace q_generation

risk_calibration.unit: one complete q-independent matched potential-outcome trace within an exact controlled profile
risk_calibration.replay_score: maximum over policies prac_hcms, prac_fixed8 and prac_fixed24_no_salvage and every nonempty eligible candidate prefix k of cumulative_actual_replay_through_k divided by cumulative_base_replay_charge_through_k on the full no-q trace stream
risk_calibration.generation_score: maximum over all 16 path slots and all three prefix arms of return_ready_atomic_elapsed divided by base_atomic_generation_s[prefix]
risk_calibration.empty_replay_convention: if every PRAC policy has K=0 eligible candidates, replay_score=0.0; missing or malformed evidence still makes the score positive_infinity
risk_calibration.finite_rule: the rank-19 score may be positive_infinity; infinity causes all PRAC policies to abstain and fails the feasibility prediction
risk_calibration.publication_rule: capture all calibration and evaluation traces before q; publish calibration scores and seal q; then expose and project evaluation traces; publish every infinity and all role/capture-order evidence
risk_calibration.unconditional_guarantee: before observing calibration, each named PRAC policy on one randomly role-assigned evaluation trace from the same controlled profile has marginal replay-score and generation-score coverage at least 19/20 separately
risk_calibration.conditioning_warning: the 19/20 statement is not conditional on the realized calibration set, q being finite, q meeting an engineering ceiling, or simultaneous success of several evaluation units; all evaluation results publish regardless of q

controller.before_path: start proposed prefix m only if observed remaining generation is at least q_generation*base_atomic_generation_s[m]; otherwise return current candidates
controller.replay_admission: accept the next exact eligible candidate only if q_replay times cumulative base replay charge including it is at most 2.0 seconds
controller.absorbing_no_fit: at the first exact candidate that fails replay admission, record drop_ledger_no_fit and terminate permanently
controller.ineligible_transition: an exact-prefix eligibility failure applies only the named monotone policy transition and may continue if the next path passes generation admission
controller.path_cap: stop before path slot 17 regardless of remaining budget
controller.publication: retain sampled root, roles, capture order, every potential arm, q values, policy projections, removals, infinities, timeouts and COMPLETE-last reconciliation

inherited_policy.definition: initialize state 24, propose state, return longest exact prefix in 24,8,1, set state=min(previous_state,returned_prefix), and set state=1 after exact ineligible drop
inherited_policy.causal_claim: none; candidate-boundary amortization is not claimed or inferred from the antecedent aggregate ratio
inherited_policy.decision: the inherited HCMS base is retained only if full PRAC HCMS aggregate raw is at least 1.10 times the stronger valid simple PRAC comparator

prac_fixed8.proposal: always propose min(8,current monotone state), initialized to 8
prac_fixed8.transition: state=min(previous_state,returned_prefix); exact ineligible drop sets state=1; replay no-fit is absorbing

prac_fixed24_no_salvage.transition: remain 24 after exact ineligible drop; replay no-fit is absorbing

point_hcms_retry.risk_controller: q_replay=q_generation=1, old 0.1-second point reserve, retry after replay no-fit
